# TrainHeroic Marketplace

> > A curated marketplace connecting athletes with elite training programs from world-class coaches including Dave Spitz, Paul Carter, Matt Wenning, and Joe Bennett across strength, tactical, bodybuilding, and functional fitness disciplines.

TrainHeroic Marketplace serves as a centralized platform where athletes can discover and subscribe to professionally-designed training programs spanning multiple disciplines. Programs are created by renowned coaches from organizations like California Strength, Paragon Training Methods, and Power Athlete, with options ranging from beginner-friendly plans to advanced Olympic weightlifting and tactical training for first responders.

## Training Categories

- [TrainHeroic Marketplace | The World's Best Training Programs All in One Place](https://marketplace.trainheroic.com): Homepage showcasing elite training programs from top coaches like Paul Carter
- [Shop Strength and Conditioning Training Programs and Coaching | TrainHeroic Marketplace](https://marketplace.trainheroic.com/interest/strength-conditioning): S&C programs featuring GBRS Performance, Matt Wenning & Dave Spitz
- [Shop Bodybuilding Training Programs and Coaching | TrainHeroic Marketplace](https://marketplace.trainheroic.com/interest/bodybuilding): Bodybuilding programs collection featuring Joe Bennett & Josh Bryant
- [Shop Functional Fitness Training Programs and Coaching | TrainHeroic Marketplace](https://marketplace.trainheroic.com/interest/functional-fitness): Functional fitness programs with Brent Fikowski & California Strength
- [Shop Tactical Training Programs and Coaching | TrainHeroic Marketplace](https://marketplace.trainheroic.com/interest/tactical): Tactical/military training programs for law enforcement & first responders
